dialogue.content: こんばんは。相談員です。来ていただき、ありがとうございます。最初に、年齢・性別・ご相談内容を教えて下さい。
dialogue.English: Good evening. I'm the counselor. Thank you for coming. First, could you please tell me your age, gender, and what you'd like to discuss?

dialogue.content: こんばんは40代男性仕事についてです
dialogue.English: Good evening. I'm a man in my 40s. It's about work.

dialogue.content: 教えて頂き、ありがとうございます。お仕事について、お悩みなのですね。具体的には、どのようなことでしょう?
dialogue.English: Thank you for sharing that. So, you're concerned about your work. Could you tell me more specifically what's on your mind?

dialogue.content: いろいろあって注意したら言いすぎてしまって逆に上司に注意されてしまって…
dialogue.English: There were a lot of things going on, and when I pointed something out, I said too much and ended up getting reprimanded by my boss instead...

dialogue.content: 納得してない感じです
dialogue.English: I just don't feel I can accept it.

dialogue.content: そうでしたか。相手のことを思って注意したのに、逆に注意されてしまったのですね。それでは納得できないですよね。
dialogue.English: I see. You were trying to help by pointing it out, but ended up getting reprimanded yourself. It's understandable that you can't accept that.

dialogue.content: ちなみに、お仕事は何をされているのでしょう?
dialogue.English: By the way, what kind of work do you do?

dialogue.content: そうですね…
dialogue.English: Well...

dialogue.content: 仕事は介護系です
dialogue.English: I work in caregiving.

dialogue.content: そうなのですね。もうベテランの職員さんですね。
dialogue.English: I see. You must be quite an experienced staff member by now.

dialogue.content: 具体的には、どのようなことを注意したのでしょう?
dialogue.English: Could you tell me specifically what you pointed out to them?

dialogue.content: 言いにくいのであれば、言わなくても大丈夫ですよ。
dialogue.English: If it's difficult to talk about, you don't have to.

dialogue.content: ベテランかはわからないです
dialogue.English: I don't know if I'd call myself a veteran.

dialogue.content: やれてない事を注意しました
dialogue.English: I pointed out things that weren't being done.

dialogue.content: 言いすぎた部分があり注意を受けた感じです
dialogue.English: It seems I went too far in how I said it and got reprimanded.

dialogue.content: そうなのですね。やれてないこと、とは、相手の方にやって欲しいことをして貰えなかった、ということでしょうか?
dialogue.English: I see. By 'things that weren't being done,' do you mean the other person wasn't doing what you wanted them to do?

dialogue.content: やるのが普通の事でできてないから注意した感じです。
dialogue.English: It was something that should be done as a matter of course, but they weren't doing it, so I pointed it out.

dialogue.content: そうでしたか。当たり前に、やらなければならないことだったのですね。それは注意したくなりますよね。
dialogue.English: I see. So it was something that should have been done as a basic part of the job. It's natural that you'd want to point that out.

dialogue.content: 注意しても変わらないから意味ないんですけどね…
dialogue.English: But even if I point it out, nothing changes, so it feels pointless...

dialogue.content: 逆に注意されるくらいだしてあ
dialogue.English: And I end up getting reprimanded instead...

dialogue.content: そうなのですね。それはもどかしいですよね。相手の方は改善が見られなくて…。それでも、相談者様が前におっしゃったように、ちょっと言い過ぎた感じなのですね。
dialogue.English: I understand. That must be very frustrating. The other person shows no signs of improvement... And yet, as you mentioned before, you feel you went a little too far.

dialogue.content: 注意した方がバカみますね…言わない人が普通にしてるのも嫌だしなんだかなぁ…
dialogue.English: It makes the one who speaks up look foolish... I also dislike how people who say nothing just carry on as usual. It's all so discouraging...

dialogue.content: そのように思われるのですね。上司の方は、その状況を知っていらっしゃるのでしょうか?
dialogue.English: That's how it feels to you. Is your supervisor aware of the situation?

dialogue.content: 上司に注意されたので知ってるとは思いますが…
dialogue.English: Since I was reprimanded by my supervisor, I think they know...

dialogue.content: そうでしたか。でも、相談者様は、見過ごせなくて注意したのですね。この仕事にやりがい等を感じていらっしやるのでしょうか?
dialogue.English: I see. But you couldn't just overlook it, so you said something. Do you feel a sense of purpose or fulfillment in this job?

dialogue.content: 相手が見えている仕事なので自分の感情だけで変わるのは違うと思っていて相手を思うなら違うと思ったら言ってしまう感じです…
dialogue.English: Since it's a job where the clients are directly affected, I think it's wrong to change based on my emotions alone. If I think something's off for the client's sake, I end up saying it...

dialogue.content: そうなのですね。相談者様の仕事に対する誠実さが伝わってきます。介護の仕事って奥がふかいのですね。
dialogue.English: I see. Your sincerity toward your work really comes through. Caregiving is such a profound job.

dialogue.content: 仕事内容より人によるよなぁって思ってきています…
dialogue.English: I'm starting to think it depends more on the person than the job itself...

dialogue.content: そうなのですね。相談者様が言い過ぎたと思うくらいに注意しても、相手の方は変わらない…。本当に、人によるのですね。
dialogue.English: I see. Even when you point things out to the extent that you feel you've gone too far, the other person doesn't change... It really does depend on the person, doesn't it.

dialogue.content: ちなみに、上司の方は、相手の方のそのような問題をどのように見ていらっしゃるのでしょう?
dialogue.English: By the way, how does your supervisor view that other person's behavior?

dialogue.content: それはわからないです。言いすぎたけど過程は違ったけど結果は思ってだからそこは間違っていないとは言われたので…
dialogue.English: I don't know. They did tell me that while I might have said too much—that the process was wrong—the result I was aiming for was right, so I wasn't wrong in that respect...

dialogue.content: そうだったのですね。それでも納得はされていないのですね?
dialogue.English: I see. But you're still not satisfied with that, are you?

dialogue.content: 納得できる部分がないので…
dialogue.English: There's nothing about it that I can accept...

dialogue.content: ならその注意された人も注意されてない時点で納得はできないので…
dialogue.English: Because if the person I reprimanded isn't also reprimanded, then I can't accept it.

dialogue.content: そうですよね。相手の方は注意をうけていないのですね?
dialogue.English: That's right. So the other person hasn't been reprimanded?

dialogue.content: 受けていないですね…
dialogue.English: No, they weren't...

dialogue.content: そうでしたか、何か腑に落ちないですよね。相談者様は、上司の方が、どのような態度であったなら、納得できたと思いますか?
dialogue.English: I see, that doesn't seem right, does it? What kind of attitude from your supervisor do you think would have made you feel you could accept the situation?

dialogue.content: 態度はどうでもいいですが全てにおいて忖度なく平等なら納得します。
dialogue.English: I don't care about their attitude, but I would accept it if they were fair and equal to everyone, without any favoritism.

dialogue.content: ということは、すべての職員に対して、平等ではない感じなのですね?
dialogue.English: So, it feels like not all staff are treated equally?

dialogue.content: そう感じる所はあります。
dialogue.English: Yes, there are times I feel that way.

dialogue.content: そうでしたか、職場がちよっと窮屈に感じていらっしやる感じでしょうか?
dialogue.English: I see. Does that make the workplace feel a bit restrictive or uncomfortable for you?

dialogue.content: 職場というより全てにおいて忖度なくされているなら納得します…
dialogue.English: It's not so much about the workplace itself... I would just be satisfied if everything was done without favoritism.

dialogue.content: そうなのですね。忖度ってあまりいい響きではないですものね。相談者様は、思ったこと、感じたことを素直に伝えることが出来る方なのですね。
dialogue.English: I see. 'Favoritism' certainly doesn't have a very good ring to it, does it? It sounds like you're someone who can honestly express what you think and feel.

dialogue.content: 子供なので我慢ができないだけなんですけどね…
dialogue.English: It's just that I'm childish and can't hold back...

dialogue.content: そのようなことは無いですよ。介護のお仕事は人間相手のお仕事ですから、気持ちのこもった援助を受けたら嬉しいと思います。そのお気持ちを持ち続けることは、とても大切だと思います。
dialogue.English: That's not true at all. Nursing care is a job that deals with people, so I think they would be happy to receive care that comes from the heart. I believe it's very important for you to continue holding onto that feeling.

dialogue.content: そうなんですかね…仕事をしている人にも共用している部分があるのかなと思っていて…
dialogue.English: I suppose so... I was thinking that maybe there are aspects of that which are shared among my coworkers as well...

dialogue.content: そのようにお考えなのですね。多少はあるのかもしれませんね。忖度、という波に乗る必要はないと思いますが、相談者様らしさを失わずに、お仕事を続けていられたら、と思います。
dialogue.English: That's what you're thinking. Perhaps there is some of that. I don't think you need to ride the wave of 'favoritism,' so to speak, but I hope you can continue your work without losing what makes you you.

dialogue.content: 相手がいる仕事なので違うと思うところはあります。間違っている時もあるのはわかりますが結果があっていても過程が言い過ぎとかだと納得できない部分がやはりあります…
dialogue.English: It's a job that involves other people, so there are things I disagree with. I know I'm wrong sometimes, but when the outcome is right and I'm still told the process was 'saying too much,' there's a part of me that just can't accept it...

dialogue.content: そうでしたか。結果はあっているけど、過程が言い過ぎ…。過程も大切だとおもわれますが、結果が大事、という雰囲気なのでしょうか?
dialogue.English: I see. The outcome was right, but the process involved 'saying too much'... You seem to think the process is also important, but is the atmosphere there one where the result is all that matters?

dialogue.content: どうなんでしょう。なら正直注意してから言ってこいとも思います…
dialogue.English: I'm not sure. But honestly, if that's the case, I feel like they should reprimand the other person first before coming to me...

dialogue.content: それができないのにうるさいからとも思っています。
dialogue.English: I feel like they can't even do that, so they have no right to complain to me.

dialogue.content: 自身が直すところは理解して治しますが、なら自分は言えるだけ見えてるの？ってのが正直な気持ちです。
dialogue.English: I understand what I need to fix about myself and I'll work on it, but my honest feeling is, 'Do you really see enough to be lecturing me?'

dialogue.content: そうなのですね。上司の方への不満はまだまだ出てきそうですね。お話の途中ですが、お時間となってしまいました。
dialogue.English: I see. It sounds like you still have a lot of frustration towards your supervisor. I'm sorry to interrupt, but we're out of time for today.

dialogue.content: このお話の続きはまだ次回に、ということで、またいつでもお話しにいらして下さい。
dialogue.English: We can continue this conversation next time, so please feel free to come back and talk anytime.

dialogue.content: そうですね。今日は、話を聞いてくださりありございます。
dialogue.English: Yes, you're right. Thank you for listening to me today.

dialogue.content: こちらこそお聞かせいただき、ありがとうございました。
dialogue.English: No, thank you for sharing your story with me.

dialogue.content: これで終了とさせて頂いてもよろしいでしょうか。
dialogue.English: Is it all right if we conclude the session here?

dialogue.content: 大丈夫です。ありがとうございました。
dialogue.English: Yes, that's fine. Thank you very much.

dialogue.content: （ありがとうございました。）
dialogue.English: (Thank you.)

dialogue.content: （こちらからありがとうございました）
dialogue.English: (No, thank you.)
